plates.text: Blue so dark it's almost black.
plates.alt: A flat square of very dark blue.

plates.text: Darkness so dark it seems like an object or a volume (dark substance).
plates.alt: White dust falls and stops at the edge of a block that cannot be seen.

plates.text: Light so bright it seems like an object or a volume (light substance).
plates.alt: Black dust falls on white and stops at the edge of a block that cannot be seen.

plates.text: White pencil on a slightly different white-toned sheet.
plates.alt: A faint hatched disc in white on an off-white sheet.

plates.text: Reds at 3 to 4%, on white.
plates.alt: A very faint pink disc on white.

plates.text: Light piercing dark substance.
plates.alt: A thin line of sparkling white pixels crosses the dark and fades.

plates.text: Red lasers piercing dark substances.
plates.alt: Two red lines cross, visible only where dust passes through them.

plates.text: Polished tree fossils with sand.
plates.alt: A cross-section of tree rings, with sand around the edge.

plates.text: A sliced stone
plates.alt: Rings of a stone change as the cut moves through it.

plates.text: A hole of light in dark substance.
plates.alt: A bright disc in the dark, slowly opening and closing.

plates.text: The whitish texture inside a hole drilled through transparent material.
plates.alt: A clear block with a speckled white shaft drilled through it.

plates.text: Beam of light that creates and destroys space in the blink of an eye.
plates.alt: A beam sweeps once across a dark room, showing parts of it, then all goes dark.

plates.text: Space defined by smell.
plates.alt: A cloud of drifting specks spreads from one corner.

plates.text: Space defined by light.
plates.alt: A pool of light on the floor. A figure shows only while crossing it.

plates.text: Space defined by sound.
plates.alt: The plan of a room, with dust gathering along lines that shift between two patterns.

plates.text: Space defined by temperature and humidity.
plates.alt: Contour lines drift across the plate.

plates.text: A rotating dividing wall.
plates.alt: A plan of a room with a wall turning on a central pivot.

plates.text: Iridescence.
plates.alt: Two sets of rings overlap and make shifting bands.

plates.text: Lamps with different colour temperature illuminating an object.
plates.alt: A sphere lit from each side, with dots from one lamp and lines from the other.

plates.text: Different resolution of textures carved into the same stone.
plates.alt: Bands of carved pyramids, each half the size of the band above, under a turning light.

plates.text: Objects made of variations of the same material.
plates.alt: Four identical vessels, from sparse to solid.

plates.text: A space made of the same material, illuminated with different colour temperatures.
plates.alt: Four identical niches, each filled with a different texture of light.

plates.text: Different effects of time on the same material.
plates.alt: Four identical blocks, each more worn away.

plates.text: Lighting dark objects with candles.
plates.alt: A flickering flame lights the lower part of a dark vase.

plates.text: A mirror underneath or behind an object, revealing something that would be invisible.
plates.alt: A box on a shelf, with a mirror below showing the marks on its underside.

plates.text: Objects that only reveal their beauty if illuminated with a certain type of light.
plates.alt: A band of light crosses the dark and shows a pattern only where it falls.

plates.text: Opposing mirrors.
plates.alt: Squares nested inside squares, with a moving light repeated in each.

plates.text: Angled opposing mirrors.
plates.alt: A moving line reflected six times around a centre.

plates.text: The reflection of a reflection.
plates.alt: A letter F, then its reflection, then the reflection of that.

plates.text: A mirror that lets you see how you look within the space you are in.
plates.alt: A figure walks while its reflection moves in a tall mirror.

plates.text: The "V" from an architectural perspective.
plates.alt: Lines converge on one point, which moves as the viewer moves.

plates.text: The angles from which paintings are looked at in a gallery.
plates.alt: A painting narrows and widens as you walk past it.

plates.text: Transparent and irregular surfaces that distort what is seen through them.
plates.alt: Straight vertical lines bend as lumps of glass pass in front of them.

plates.text: Angled (bevelled) transparent surfaces that distort what is seen through them.
plates.alt: A moving grid jumps sideways as it passes under the bevelled edges of a pane.

plates.text: A set of superimposed prisms that geometrically distort what is seen through them.
plates.alt: Vertical lines broken into sliding steps.

plates.text: Dark wood painted white where it was cut.
plates.alt: Dark grain with a solid white cut edge.

plates.text: Marble with inlays.
plates.alt: White marble with thin veins and a diamond inlay.

plates.text: Marquetry of semi-precious stones.
plates.alt: Irregular fitted pieces, each with its own tone.

plates.text: Semi-precious stones embedded in wood.
plates.alt: Oval stones set into wood grain.

plates.text: Rough marble or granite on rough wood.
plates.alt: A speckled rough block resting on heavy grain.

plates.text: The sound of music contrasted with silence.
plates.alt: A busy sound wave drops to a flat line.

plates.text: The contrast of wood with bronze.
plates.alt: Wood grain on the left, smooth shaded metal on the right.

plates.text: The iridescence of Roman glass.
plates.alt: A shard with patches of tone that shift.

plates.text: A rough piece of melted glass
plates.alt: A blob outline with bubbles that slowly sags.

plates.text: A mound of earth shaped by drops of water.
plates.alt: Drops fall on a mound and slowly wear it down.

plates.text: Dripped glazes.
plates.alt: A white glaze runs slowly down the plate.

plates.text: Paint on glass, overlaid.
plates.alt: Three hatched panes slide over one another.

plates.text: Painted stone
plates.alt: A speckled stone with a painted band.

plates.text: A structure that duplicates when supported by a mirror.
plates.alt: An arcade standing on a line, repeated upside down below it.

plates.text: Double symmetry.
plates.alt: A shifting shape mirrored both left to right and top to bottom.

plates.text: Central vestibular spaces of great height.
plates.alt: A very tall shaft of light between walls, with a tiny figure at the bottom.

plates.text: Natural continuation of a body, interrupted.
plates.alt: A curve breaks off and carries on across a gap.

plates.text: Mono-instrument music with unusually long silences.
plates.alt: A single mark sounds and fades, followed by a long empty pause.

plates.text: A very large and heavy object that does not rest on the object beneath it.
plates.alt: A huge white block above a smaller one. The thin gap between them widens slightly.

plates.text: Monotonous music.
plates.alt: Eight equal bars, marked one by one.

plates.text: A 100-year time-lapse (Myanmar).
plates.alt: A building rises and crumbles as the sun races overhead.

plates.text: Reading dense poetry as ambient sound.
plates.alt: Lines of blocks that stand for words scroll slowly upwards.

plates.text: Jungle vegetation framed by a window.
plates.alt: Leaves sway behind a window frame.

plates.text: Holes you can look through.
plates.alt: Three holes in a white wall. The dots behind them shift as you move.

plates.text: Axonometric and isometric perspectives.
plates.alt: A cluster of blocks changing from an isometric view to an axonometric one and back.

plates.text: A doorway framing an object in the next room.
plates.alt: Walking towards a doorway, with an object in the room beyond growing larger.

plates.text: Rectangular boxes with stripes of different colours arranged in a regular grid.
plates.alt: Nine boxes in a grid, each with different stripes.

plates.text: Watching others without them knowing you're watching them
plates.alt: Figures walk past behind a small round peephole.

plates.text: A small model of the space you are in
plates.alt: A room containing a model of itself, and a figure walking in both.

plates.text: Successively self-contained prisms rotating on the same axis.
plates.alt: Three wire cubes, one inside another, turning on one axis.

plates.text: A cloud moving very slowly, almost still, in a confined space.
plates.alt: A small dotted cloud drifting inside a square outline.

plates.text: Secret compartments inside secret compartments.
plates.alt: Sliding lids reveal a box inside a box inside a box.

plates.text: Statues placed inside statues.
plates.alt: A zoom into a figure that holds a smaller figure, and another inside that.

plates.text: Objects arranged equidistantly.
plates.alt: Seven rows of seven small squares, evenly spaced.

plates.text: The relationship between the space you’re in and the taste of something eaten there.
plates.alt: Each bite taken from a round plate removes a piece of the room around it.

plates.text: An interior open space exposed to the weather
plates.alt: Rain falls through a gap in a roof into a room.

plates.text: A good seat to sit and contemplate.
plates.alt: A figure on a bench watches the sun go down.

plates.text: Juxtaposition of the same object but in different scales.
plates.alt: The same arch at three sizes.

plates.text: Furniture that encourages social interaction.
plates.alt: Dots gather around a ring-shaped seat in plan.

plates.text: Subtle changes in repetition.
plates.alt: Vertical lines appear one at a time, each a copy of the last with one small change.

plates.text: Repetition of an almost identical object.
plates.alt: A grid of identical marks, with one reversed in a different place each time.

plates.text: An object placed on a very high plinth
plates.alt: A tiny ball on a tall column, with a small figure beside it.

plates.text: Mounds of a single material.
plates.alt: Grains fall in a thin stream and build a cone.

plates.text: 8-bit and pixelation.
plates.alt: A shaded sphere going from large blocks to fine dots and back.

plates.text: The space a censored piece would have occupied.
plates.alt: A pan along a gallery wall, where one picture is only a dotted outline.

plates.text: Strobe lights on a chaotic pendulum.
plates.alt: A double pendulum caught as a trail of frozen positions.
